// ReportTests.cs
// Part 4 (Thursday). Rename this file to ReportTests.cs when the lab says so.
// Both tests fail on the ShiftReport you were given. Each failure is one
// of the warnings the build has been printing all week. Do not edit this file.

using Line3.Monitor;

namespace Line3.Monitor.Tests;

public class ReportTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void P4_01_the_title_appears_in_the_report()
    {
        var report = new ShiftReport("Line 3, second shift");
        report.Note = "oven drifted after the changeover";
        report.Add(new Reading("oven-temp", 212.44, 1));
        report.Add(new Reading("oven-temp", null, 2));
        string text = report.Render();
        Assert.StartsWith("LINE 3, SECOND SHIFT", text);
        Assert.Contains("Note: oven drifted after the changeover", text);
        Assert.Contains("#1 oven-temp: 212.4", text);
        Assert.Contains("#2 oven-temp: missing", text);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void P4_02_a_report_with_no_note_still_renders()
    {
        var report = new ShiftReport("Line 3, second shift");
        string text = report.Render();
        Assert.Contains("Note: none", text);
    }
}
